bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to children and families; appropriating money for the diaper distribution grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; DIAPER DISTRIBUTION GRANT PROGRAM. +]

[+$553,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $553,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for a grant to the Diaper Bank of Minnesota for the diaper distribution grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 142A.42. This amount is added to the base. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to children and families; appropriating money for the diaper distribution grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; DIAPER DISTRIBUTION GRANT PROGRAM.

$553,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $553,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for a grant to the Diaper Bank of Minnesota for the diaper distribution grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 142A.42. This amount is added to the base.
additions: $553,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $553,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for a grant to the Diaper Bank of Minnesota for the diaper distribution grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 142A.42. This amount is added to the base.
